about: The placeholder a rendered manifest carries in place of a private key, and which keys of a manifest still hold it. Such a manifest is never sent: a ConfigMap would store the placeholder as the key. Rust: `WITHHELD_MARKER` in src/tauri/src/resources/tls.rs and the guard in `parse_all_documents` (src/tauri/src/commands/manifest/parse.rs). TypeScript: `WITHHELD_MARKER` and `withheldKeysIn` in src/ui/routes/c/$cluster/-yaml/manifest-reads.ts, which name the keys before Apply is offered.
marker: <withheld: the app never shows a private key>

cases.name: a ConfigMap as the editor shows it
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: nginx
  namespace: shop
data:
  nginx.conf: worker_processes 2;
  server.key: '<withheld: the app never shows a private key>'

cases.name: every map a key can sit in
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: bundle
  namespace: shop
binaryData:
  bundle.p12: "<withheld: the app never shows a private key>"
stringData:
  id_rsa: '<withheld: the app never shows a private key>'

cases.name: a Secret, whose data the server would refuse anyway
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: tls
  namespace: shop
type: kubernetes.io/tls
data:
  tls.crt: Y2VydA==
  tls.key: '<withheld: the app never shows a private key>'

cases.name: reflowed into a block scalar
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: nginx
  namespace: shop
data:
  server.key: |
    <withheld: the app never shows a private key>

cases.name: in the second document of two
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: a
  namespace: shop
data:
  a: b
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: b
  namespace: shop
data:
  client.key: '<withheld: the app never shows a private key>'

cases.name: the withheld key removed from the manifest
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: nginx
  namespace: shop
data:
  nginx.conf: worker_processes 2;

cases.name: a value that only mentions the placeholder
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: notes
  namespace: shop
data:
  readme: "the app prints <withheld: the app never shows a private key> for a key"

cases.name: the placeholder outside the maps a key is read from
cases.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: notes
  namespace: shop
  annotations:
    note: '<withheld: the app never shows a private key>'
data:
  a: b
